errors.evidence: The values in the description are assigned to the wrong methods within each group. For example, in Mathverse the chart shows DAPO+Self-reflection ≈56.1, DAPO ≈53.1, SRPO ≈55.8, GRPO ≈53.4, PPO+Self-reflection ≈54.5, PPO ≈53.3; in MMLU DAPO+Self-reflection ≈56.9, DAPO ≈55.9, SRPO ≈57.1, GRPO ≈55.8, PPO+Self-reflection ≈56.2, PPO ≈54.6; in Physics DAPO+Self-reflection ≈61.0, DAPO ≈57.5, SRPO ≈60.6, GRPO ≈58.1, PPO+Self-reflection ≈59.1, PPO ≈56.9. The sentence lists the same numbers but swaps PPO and PPO+Self-reflection in Mathverse and reverses several method assignments compared with the legend/order.
In the legend and bars, PPO is shown as green with diagonal stripes, while the orange hatched bars correspond to GRPO; the description swaps the colors of PPO and GRPO.
The legend in the figure maps the solid blue bar to DAPO+Self-reflection and the hatched blue bar to DAPO, not the other way around.

The legend in the figure maps the solid green bar to PPO+Self-reflection and the hatched green bar to PPO, not the other way around; the colors are also green/teal rather than dark green vs turquoise as described.
